notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Hi dino fans,

Just a quick patch today with a few bug fixes and improvements:

Fixed an issue where the camera could get stuck on the ground if you skipped the cutscene with Natalya

Fixed a crash bug that could occur on the Paddock floor of the elevator

Added item crates as a Laboratory reward for saving your allies

Also, if you haven’t checked out my new horror demo yet, take a look at Monterey Jack! 
Make sure to wishlist so you don’t miss the full release.

That’s all for now,
DangerousBob

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 Keybinding Fix
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – Keybinding Fix

Good news! The issue where custom keybinds weren’t saved after restarting the game has been fixed. 

Your controls should now stay just how you like them. 

-DangerousBob

notes.title: Patch 1.2.9 Horde nerf
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thanks to your feedback, I've made an adjustment to Horde Mode:
Enemy cash drops have been doubled to make it easier for players to buy items and survive longer.

Bug Fix:

Fixed an issue in the Lab level where the laser trap could stop moving. It should now function as intended.

That's all for now!

– DangerousBob

notes.title: Sandbox Mode & Cinema Mode (Patch 1.2.8)
notes.notes:
Sandbox Mode Unleashed
Only a small percentage of players had discovered Sandbox Mode, so it’s now unlocked by default for everyone!
Jump in and let your creativity run wild—spawn enemies, build with blocks, and experiment freely in this chaotic, Gmod-style playground.
Just a heads-up: enemy-specific achievements are disabled in this mode.
https://i.imgur.com/LC98aKF.jpeg
Cinema Mode – Say Cheese!
When in game press "P" on your keyboard for Cinema Mode, and capture high quality screenshots! (Note this is different then the ingame camera item.)
Be warned—it’s a bit experimental and might act up, so best to use it during casual sessions, not serious runs.
https://i.imgur.com/4Q1TAeO.jpeg
New Game Announcement – Monterey Jack
I’m working on a brand-new horror game called Monterey Jack!
Sneak through a cursed cheese factory and battle terrifying cheese monsters brought to life by an evil dip.
It is kind of like my take on Poppy Playtime, check it out.
https://i.imgur.com/Zj1voLP.png
Wishlist and checkout the demo!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.7 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Some bugs that I saw on different streamer videos that I wanted to get around to fixing. 

-The Spino would sometimes get stuck in a walking animation on Horde. This is fixed.
-The Goliath could "trap" the player in the shotgun room, the Goliath will now go back to his patrol if the player goes in there.
-There was a bug where one of the roaches would move around when dead (in the room you can flood).

That's all for now.

-DangerousBob

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6 Horde Primal Difficulty Nerf
notes.notes:
Hello,

So I got a few messages that achievement hunters are stuck on the achievement for beating Horde on Primal. There is only a couple people on PC that have done it and nobody on console.

This patch should make it so this achievement is a bit more balanced. 

Changes:


 Checkpoints at wave 15 and wave 35. 

 Enemy spawns have been decreased. 

 Players start with more money on Primal vs other difficulties.

 On Primal players start with 3 NPC allies. 

 More item boxes and a second turret.
 
 A couple of small map changes, I added a trap where you can drop red barrels on the enemies.


https://i.imgur.com/CDNdP45.png

notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 small tweaking
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

This patch has some small tweaks as follows:

-The allied Mercenary NPCs have been nerfed by 10%. They were just so strong that they would tank any enemy.

-The Ammo Box on the boat in the Meg fight has been fixed. Before if you had a full inventory you would fall off the boat.

notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

notes.title: Patch v 1.1.0 Steam Deck & Freeze Frame Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Valve has passed Fossilfuel 2 for Steam Deck. Please note the game was not built for Steam Deck, but players can change the settings to run on Steam Deck. 

To get the game to run on Steam Deck

Set screen to 1280 x 720. Performance hindrances were observed on the default graphical profile. Manually setting the options to medium or patato allowed for a suitable experience.

Only the input device that engaged it will be recognized. This forces users to have to restart the game to regain controls of the Steam Deck built-in controls as the game does not allow you to return to the title screen and also doesn't provide options for switching input devices.

--

Horde Freeze Bug

I believe I have fixed the freeze frame bug on the horde map, or at least reduced its chances of happening to a great amount. There was a memory loop that was happening, and I tried to re work that. I tested it vigorously on my computer after the update and I didn't get the freeze finally, but I can't guarantee that the bug is totally gone as the loop is technically still there just done in a different way. 

Please also be sure to update your computer graphic card drivers! Especially if you have Nvidia! 

--

Game changes

There is now a max limit to the number of helper mercenaries the player can buy in horde mode. 
You can only buy helper mercenaries 5 times. This will force the player to use them in a more strategic way, and entourage players to use the turrets or buy other weapons on the horde map vs spamming mercenaries.

That is all for now,

DangerousBob

notes.notes:
This is a small patch with some tweaks to the Horde mode.

It will remain as is on the other difficulties. 

There was a bug with the difficulty not saving on the Horde mode selection with a recent patch, this is fixed.

notes.title: Patch v 1.0.8 Minor tweaks from user bugs
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

I have been taking some time away from the computer but here are a few issues that have been raised in the forum which are now fixed.

-The Horde mode doesn't use a transition checkpoint now. When you open horde it shouldn't erase your story mode auto save.

-There was a bug in the lab if you got the empty vial, died and came back the puzzle wouldn't work. This is fixed.

-The Vsync before was off by default, but said "on" and it had to be toggled off / on to actually be working. This is fixed.

-The Goliath AI was a bit buggy in the Lab. He should be a bit more smooth now and not get "stuck."

-The Goliath can now attack you when you are on stairs, before he could not as the hit detection didn't slope up.

That is all for now!

DangeorusBob

notes.title: Patch v 1.0.7 Horde adjustment
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

I have gotten some feedback about the horde mode and wanted to address it. 

The following changes have been made:

-Horde would randomly crash, this should be fixed now. Please report if it continues to crash.

-Horde mode will dynamically get harder based on how good you are. The better you play, the harder it gets. This is on top of the pre-selected difficulty. 

-There was a bug where the Blights would get lost if you were out of sight on the horde map, this is fixed.

That is all,

DangerousBob

notes.notes:
